persona.title: Persona groups
persona.sub: Q3: Living on campus or commuting
persona.note: Commuters outnumber on-campus students more than 2 to 1.

year.title: Class year
year.note: 61% seniors and only 3 freshmen, so our sample skews older.

skipped.title: Skipped or delayed meals because of time
skipped.sub: Q6: In the past two weeks, how often?
skipped.note: 20 of 23 skipped or delayed eating at least once. This confirms the core problem in our problem statement.

factor.title: Most important factor
factor.sub: Q7: When choosing where to eat between classes
factor.note: Distance is the top factor (39%), then price (22%). Nobody picked opening hours.

walk.title: How far students will walk
walk.note: 48% will only walk 5 to 9 minutes and nobody would walk 15 or more.

info.title: Where students get food info
info.note: Most rely on Google Maps, not the official dining site.

line.title: When the line is too long
line.note: 52% go somewhere else, which uses up more of their break.

feature.title: Most useful feature for a TerpBites website
feature.note: Walking distance and prices/menus tie at 35%, with wait times close behind at 26%.

interviews.title: Interview participants
interviews.sub: 19 in-person interviews, none of whom took the survey
interviews.note: Like the survey, our interviews skew toward off-campus seniors (12 of 19).

affinity.title: Survey affinity diagram, final step
affinity.sub: Yellow = student answers to Q14, blue = survey results, red = group labels
affinity.note: The full four-step process is on our project website's Affinity Diagram page.
